label: Avionics master
info: Keeps avionics off while the battery powers up.

label: Fuel quantity
info: Compare both gauges against your planned fuel.

label: Flaps
info: Lower fully, check both sides visually, then retract.

label: Walkaround
info: Often non-interactive in the sim. Tick it once you've looked around the aircraft.

label: Magnetos
info: Release to BOTH as soon as the engine fires.

label: Flight instruments
info: Heading, attitude and turn coordinator respond correctly in turns.

label: Magnetos
info: Drop on each magneto should be small and even.
